description: Turn a ticker, $cashtag, name, @handle, contract address, CoinGecko id, FIGI or CIK into the entity id that events and calls take.. It matches exactly, it is not a search: a prefix or a misspelling returns nothing. A ticker is not unique, so take the first row and check its name, or narrow with entityType. Forms of an asset share one family id where known: WBTC and cbBTC are Bitcoin. Resolve once and reuse the id.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous reply. Change any argument but limit and it fails; start again without it.

entityType.description: Narrow the match to these kinds. Omit to match every kind.

limit.description: Items per page, up to 200. Keep it small and page with cursor rather than asking for everything at once.

q.description: What you hold, for example "btc", "$SOL", "@VitalikButerin" or a contract address.

name: entities
title: Entities
